business_problem: Mondelēz International needed a better way to support enterprise-scale model experimentation, model serving, and AI-driven decision support because siloed data and disconnected model development workflows kept experimentation, supply chain optimization, and revenue growth management from scaling globally.
solution_summary: Mondelēz International uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support enterprise-scale model experimentation, model serving, and AI-driven decision support. The implementation replaced a legacy state where siloed data and disconnected model development workflows kept experimentation, supply chain optimization, and revenue growth management from scaling globally. Sales execution data and marketing data move through Lakeflow Jobs and land in shared lakehouse datasets, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog and Delta Sharing governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Model Serving, and Lakehouse Federation operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver managed experiments and served production models.
business_outcome: Mondelēz International improved enterprise-scale model experimentation, model serving, and AI-driven decision support with measurable results including 20K scaling ai innovation to drive revenue, efficiency and growth, 3K models managed in batch and real time using mlflow, and Reduced technical debt and improved experimentation on 20K models, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
